title: Pay $39.99 once to put ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more in a single workspace for life
excerpt: Compare up to six AI answers at once.
content_html:
TL;DR: One $39.99 payment gets you lifetime AskAnyModel AI Pro access, with 50+ supported AI models, comparisons of up to six responses at once, unlimited standard-model chats, and 500 monthly premium credits.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$39.99
$499 Save $459.01

Having a favorite AI model is fine until you wonder whether another one would’ve given you a better answer. AskAnyModel AI Pro is on sale for just $39.99 for lifetime access (reg. $499), putting more than 50 supported AI models into one browser-based workspace.

The big draw is comparison. Instead of copying the same prompt into a bunch of tabs, you can select two to six models, ask your question once, and see multiple answers side by side. The results include response times and token counts, making it easier to choose the response that fits your task.

The platform brings together models from providers including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama, and Mistral. You can switch models during a conversation without losing context, whether you’re writing, coding, researching, or brainstorming.

There is an important distinction in how access works. The plan includes unlimited chats with 30 standard models, plus a Pro Gemini model with Google Search grounding that’s limited to 300 chats per week. For 19 premium models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity Search options, you receive 500 credits each month.

AskAnyModel also includes unlimited AI image generation across supported models without using those premium credits.

Because everything is cloud-based, there’s nothing to download or update; you just sign in through a modern browser. The AI model library is also regularly updated with new releases and improvements.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

For anyone who regularly wonders, “What would another AI say?”, AskAnyModel AI Pro is just $39.99 for lifetime access (reg. $499).

StackSocial prices subject to change.
